When you blend it to your skin it sinks in but it feels a little sticky feeling, but it does go away after some times. It also feels hydrating to the skin, which is a big plus for me. Aloe Extract does give you that soothing effect/sensation.
It is a mix of physical & chemical sunscreen which is my favorite kind of sunscreen. Even though it contains Titanium Dioxide, it is pretty far in the ingredients list hence will not leave a white cast.
But do beware if you are sensitive to alcohol, this does contain alcohol but I don't really feel the bad effects of it in my skin. Furthermore, I am not a fan of the scent which is a but strong at the beginning but will disappear after some times.
All in all, this is a solid sunscreen with a great texture and high protection.
